I picked Dunlin-235B for a simple reason: your request is a routine writing/editing task with nothing sensitive about it, so the deciding factor was just raw capability.

Looking at the documentation, Dunlin scores higher across the benchmarks most relevant to wordsmithing — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), and IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6, useful since you gave a specific instruction to follow). Those gaps are large enough to be real rather than run-to-run noise.

The task-preference notes in the docs only really matter for harm-adjacent or distasteful content, which doesn't apply to polishing an approval request for light repairs. So with no preference considerations in play, I defaulted to the model with the stronger editing capability.
